title: Arrest warrants arising from traffic violations.
bodyText: In any criminal proceeding, due diligence shall be used in serving any outstanding traffic warrants on the defendant.
bodyHtml:
[§604-7.2]  Arrest warrants arising from traffic violations.  In any criminal proceeding, due diligence shall be used in serving any outstanding traffic warrants on the defendant. [L 2006, c 308, §3]
